summary: Frontend-only verification of the rename ('Muhd Afif') and project-removal changes, plus contact API regression. Desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844) tested on the public preview URL. All 6 requested items PASS: hero shows 'Muhd'/'Afif', About intro + footer (c) 2026 Muhd Afif, zero occurrences of 'Muhammad' in rendered text, Selected Work has exactly 4 projects numbered 01-04 (Muar River Cruise, AR Cooking Guide, Nacho Macho, Graphic Design) with 'Discovering Insects' and 'Travel Magazine' fully gone (also no source leftovers via grep), all 4 detail overlays open with full content (Overview/Objective/Process/Outcome/My Role/Tools Used/Project Gallery) and close via project-detail-close, Muar detail renders YouTube iframe (project-video, src .../embed/G1pSbhbDWUI) with exactly 3 gallery images, About stats shows '04+ SELECTED PROJECTS', page scrolls end-to-end (7808/7808px, footer visible), and contact form POST returns success toast 'Message sent. Thanks for reaching out...'. Backend contact suite 5/5 passed. No console errors, no error elements, body scroll-lock correctly released after modal close.

issues: Project index badge (text-white/70) sits over bright imagery on card 01 (Muar sky) and is effectively unreadable; badges over dark images (e.g. 02) read fine. Consider a scrim/backdrop or solid colour behind the number.

profile.resumeUrl asset filename still contains 'MUHAMMAD AFIF BIN AZHAR', so the downloaded file is named with the old name even though all on-page text is now 'Muhd Afif'. Cosmetic-only; requires re-uploading the PDF to fully align with the rename.

action_items: Optional: improve contrast of the project index badge over light card images (mobile).
Optional: re-upload resume PDF with a 'Muhd Afif' filename so the download matches the new name.
critical_code_review_comments: portfolio.js is the single source of truth and is consistent: projects array has 4 items with sequential index 01-04, stats[0] = '04+', profile.name = 'Muhd Afif'. No orphaned ids referenced elsewhere.

ProjectDetail unconditionally reads project.gallery/project.tools; both are present for all 4 projects today, but adding a future project without these keys would throw. Consider optional chaining with a fallback array.
Detail modal labels are uppercased via CSS text-transform, so automated text assertions must be case-insensitive (noted for future test agents).
seed_data_creation: One contact message created via UI (name 'TEST_QA Afif', qa_test@example.com) plus records from the backend pytest suite.
test_credentials: None required - public single-page portfolio, no auth (per /app/memory/test_credentials.md).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All rename + project-removal changes verified on desktop and mobile; nothing broken. Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_contact_api.py for backend regression. When asserting detail-modal section labels, use case-insensitive matching (CSS uppercases 'TOOLS USED', 'PROJECT GALLERY', stat labels). Gallery image counts: Muar 3, AR Cooking 3, Nacho 2, Graphic Design 2; only Muar has a video iframe. Two open cosmetic items: mobile index-badge contrast and the resume PDF filename still containing the old name.
rca_of_the_issue: Initial run showed 5 apparent failures (About stats + all 4 project details). RCA: these were false negatives in my own test script - assertions used case-sensitive substrings ('Selected Projects', 'Tools Used', 'Project Gallery') while the UI uppercases those labels via CSS text-transform, which is reflected in inner_text(). Re-running with case-insensitive matching produced 100% pass. No application defect.
